question: Should `plugin-sdk/media-base64` become a supported public Plugin SDK subpath as part of the canonical WhatsApp media refactor?
rationale: The implementation is not merely a local cleanup: it adds a documented package export, baseline allowance, and external contract that cannot be safely chosen by an automated repair lane.

options.title: Approve the focused public facade
options.body: Accept `plugin-sdk/media-base64` as the narrow supported contract and merge with its documented replacement path for broad media helpers.

options.title: Keep base64 parsing non-public
options.body: Retain the WhatsApp cleanup but redesign the shared helper behind an existing internal or explicitly owner-scoped seam if external plugins should not receive this new API.

recommendation.title: Approve the focused public facade
recommendation.body: Accept `plugin-sdk/media-base64` as the narrow supported contract and merge with its documented replacement path for broad media helpers.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor directly to the proposed WhatsApp/media ownership split and public SDK surface.
